scenarios.title: Body Defence Sequence
scenarios.answer: Immune memory belongs to adaptive immunity; vaccination prepares a response and is not an instant cure.
scenarios.predictionPrompt: Where does immune memory belong in this teaching model?
scenarios.explanationPrompt: Distinguish barriers, innate response and adaptive response. Explain how adaptive immune memory and vaccination relate; the responses can overlap.
scenarios.keyIdea: Immune memory is a retained feature of adaptive immunity, not an independent fourth barrier. Vaccination prepares a response rather than providing an instant cure.
scenarios.teacherReasoning: Barrier limits entry; innate response is broad; adaptive response is specific and can retain immune memory. Memory belongs to adaptive immunity, not a separate fourth barrier; vaccination prepares a response rather than an instant cure.
